name: Yaladai (Pure)
description: Yaladai is a powerful stimulant that grants extreme clarity, improving relaxation and focus. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next hour, the creature experiences a high that increases their current and maximum force points by 2d12. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw or experience a low that lasts 8 hours, their current and maximum force points are reduced by 2d12. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw to resist addiction.
